## Objective
<!-- One user-visible goal, acceptance criteria and explicitly excluded scope. -->

## Builder evidence
<!-- Implementation commit/head SHA, changed files, unit/integration tests actually executed, compatibility, known limits, dated docs/routine log path. -->

## Audit request
<!-- Specific assumptions, failure modes and tests Agent B should challenge independently. NO self-reported "independent audit passed". -->

## Next decision
<!-- Pending Agent B: outcome, one chosen next priority, evidence and acceptance conditions. Builder must not fill this as if a reviewer approved it. -->

---
**Merge policy:** Needs real independent reviewer evidence on current PR head and passing CI, plus maintainer decision. A same-session check does not count as independent review.
